name: Stale Api Upgrade
essence: A mixed-in receipt helper still calls amount after the billing API exposes totalCents instead.

examples.summary: A mixed-in receipt helper still calls amount after the billing API exposes totalCents instead.
examples.mechanism: Object.assign installs a helper with an old method dependency onto the newer API object; the unchecked optional amount call throws.
examples.observed_output: TypeError: this.amount is not a function
examples.expected_behavior: Update the helper to use totalCents and print receipt 450.

ingredients.suggests: Object.assign mixes a helper with a hidden amount dependency into the billing object.
The provided billing API offers totalCents while the helper still invokes amount.

examples.summary: A mixed-in receipt helper still invokes an API method that the billing implementation renamed..

ingredients.suggests: A mixin adds a receipt method with a hidden dependency on its host's amount method.

examples.summary: An embedded helper calls an old method name absent from the upgraded billing map.
examples.mechanism: A map of method names is the dynamic API escape hatch; an embedded helper invokes a missing function after an API rename.
